legend: There are n sharks who grow flowers for Wet Shark. They are all sitting around the table, such that sharks i and i + 1 are neighbours for all i from 1 to n - 1. Sharks n and 1 are neighbours too.

Each shark will grow some number of flowers si. For i-th shark value si is random integer equiprobably chosen in range from li to ri. Wet Shark has it's favourite prime number p, and he really likes it! If for any pair of neighbouring sharks i and j the product si·sj is divisible by p, then Wet Shark becomes happy and gives 1000 dollars to each of these sharks.
At the end of the day sharks sum all the money Wet Shark granted to them. Find the expectation of this value.
input: The first line of the input contains two space-separated integers n and p (3 ≤ n ≤ 100 000, 2 ≤ p ≤ 109) — the number of sharks and Wet Shark's favourite prime number. It is guaranteed that p is prime.

The i-th of the following n lines contains information about i-th shark — two space-separated integers li and ri (1 ≤ li ≤ ri ≤ 109), the range of flowers shark i can produce. Remember that si is chosen equiprobably among all integers from li to ri, inclusive.
output: Print a single real number — the expected number of dollars that the sharks receive in total. You answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed 10 - 6.

Namely: let's assume that your answer is a, and the answer of the jury is b. The checker program will consider your answer correct, if ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png).
note: A prime number is a positive integer number that is divisible only by 1 and itself. 1 is not considered to be prime.

Consider the first sample. First shark grows some number of flowers from 1 to 2, second sharks grows from 420 to 421 flowers and third from 420420 to 420421. There are eight cases for the quantities of flowers (s0, s1, s2) each shark grows:

(1, 420, 420420): note that s0·s1 = 420, s1·s2 = 176576400, and s2·s0 = 420420. For each pair, 1000 dollars will be awarded to each shark. Therefore, each shark will be awarded 2000 dollars, for a total of 6000 dollars.
(1, 420, 420421): now, the product s2·s0 is not divisible by 2. Therefore, sharks s0 and s2 will receive 1000 dollars, while shark s1 will receive 2000. The total is 4000.
In the second sample, no combination of quantities will garner the sharks any money.

note.ai: 素数是一个正整数，它只能被 1 和自身整除。1 不被认为是素数。
考虑第一个样例。第一条鲨鱼会产生 1 到 2 朵花，第二条鲨鱼会产生 420 到 421 朵花，第三条鲨鱼会产生 420420 到 420421 朵花。对于每条鲨鱼产生的花朵数量 (s0, s1, s2)，一共有八种情况：
(1, 420, 420421)：现在，乘积 s2·s0 不能被 2 整除。因此，鲨鱼 s0 和 s2 将获得 1000 美元，而鲨鱼 s1 将获得 2000 美元。总计为 4000 美元。
在第二个样例中，无论选择何种数量组合，鲨鱼都无法赚到钱。

legend.ai: 有 n 条鲨鱼为湿鲨鱼种植鲜花。它们围坐在一张桌子旁，使得对于从 1 到 n - 1 的所有 i，鲨鱼 i 和 i + 1 互为邻居。鲨鱼 n 和鲨鱼 1 也互为邻居。
每条鲨鱼都会种植数量为 si 的鲜花。对于第 i 条鲨鱼，数值 si 是在 li 到 ri 的范围内等概率随机选取的整数。湿鲨鱼有一个最喜欢的素数 p，他非常喜欢这个素数！如果对于任意一对相邻的鲨鱼 i 和 j，乘积 si·sj 能被 p 整除，那么湿鲨鱼就会感到高兴，并给这两条鲨鱼各 1000 美元。
一天结束时，鲨鱼们将湿鲨鱼发给它们的所有钱加起来。求这个总金额的期望值。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 n 和 p（3 ≤ n ≤ 100 000， 2 ≤ p ≤ 109）——鲨鱼的数量以及 Wet Shark 最喜欢的素数。保证 p 是素数。
接下来的 n 行中，第 i 行包含关于第 i 条鲨鱼的信息——两个用空格分隔的整数 li 和 ri（1 ≤ li ≤ ri ≤ 109），表示第 i 条鲨鱼能够产生的花朵数量范围。请记住，si 在从 li 到 ri（包括 li 和 ri）的所有整数中等概率地选取。

output.ai: 输出一个实数——鲨鱼总共获得的美元数量的期望值。如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10 - 6，则会被判定为正确。
具体来说：假设你的答案为 a，评测答案为 b。检查程序会在 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png) 时判定你的答案正确。
